question_text: Outline two advantages of using inheritance for related Product types.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Common fields/methods can be defined once in Product and reused by subclasses, reducing duplication. A correction to shared inherited behaviour can then benefit those subclasses without separately patching many copies, improving maintenance consistency.
